verdict.rationale: Shortcut documents a REST v3 API for automation, so this axis applies, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions API rate limits, request quotas, or concurrency caps. The 'story limits' feature refers to work-in-progress limits per workflow state, not API throttling, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I know the documented API rate limits and concurrency caps before building automation at scale
